set_response_owner.brief_text: Responses to talking will be brief now.
set_response_owner.verbose_text: Responses to talking will be verbose now.

resolver_contract.help_fast: You do NOT need to precede your line with a character. Just type whatever you wish to say and it will be said to the room.
resolver_contract.help_slow: You must precede all talking with a character if you want to speak to the room.
resolver_contract.dll_fast_text: Anything you type which is not recognized will be sent to the room.
resolver_contract.dll_slow_text: To talk to the room, you must begin your line with a %c

page.persistence: live-session only; no character-record PAGE byte in the recovered save/load profile block
page.standalone_help: Typing page will toggle on/off the ability for other users on the system to page you while you are in the game.
page.set_on_text: Paging is now set to Ok.
page.set_off_text: Paging is now set to Off.

maxpages.help: Limits the number of pages or telegrams you want to receive in each 3 second period

still_open: exact Worldgroup host PAGE/telegram send/handoff protocol

megamud.compatibility_rule: MegaMUD-visible command parsing must preserve TALK FAST fallback, TALK SLOW command rejection, explicit SAY/dot speech, and native PAGE setting text without a Reforged-only prompt.

borin.compatibility_rule: Borin uses explicit SAY for generated room dialogue and therefore must not depend on TALK FAST. Native brief response text and command-not-recognized text are accepted as ordinary server responses rather than private protocol data.
